title: Black hole information paradox: unitarity of evaporation
bottleneck: Hawking's semiclassical calculation shows black holes evaporate into purely thermal radiation carrying no information, which would convert pure quantum states into mixed ones and violate unitarity, a core principle of quantum mechanics. Reconciling unitary evolution with the smooth spacetime of general relativity at the horizon remains unresolved despite fifty years of effort.
why_it_blocks: The paradox forces a choice between quantum mechanics and general relativity at their point of sharpest conflict; whichever principle gives way rewrites the foundations of physics.
current_state: Recent island-formula calculations reproduce the expected Page curve for the radiation entropy in AdS models, suggesting unitarity holds, but the microscopic mechanism transferring information into the radiation is still unknown.
